name: Velbert (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:4:1, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Velbert (a white key with an oak leaf on red).
history: The right to bear arms was granted to the city by King Wilhelm I of Prussia in 1882 and confirmed by the Regierungspräsident on 21 June 1976; the city flag is striped horizontally red, white and red in the ratio 1:4:1 with the city shield shifted towards the staff.

features.role: Velbert arms — key with oak leaf on red
